figures.caption: Figure 1: Illustrative examples of three medical calculation scenarios: single-calculator, multi-calculator, and nested-calculator scenarios.
Table 2: Main results on the single-calculator and multi-calculator tasks (%). The best and second best results are highlighted in bold and underline.

Table 1: Comparison of medical calculator benchmarks. “Fuzzy Query” indicates whether the benchmark includes goal-driven queries that do not explicitly specify the target calculator. “Proc. Eval.” denotes whether process-level evaluation is provided. “Multi-calculator” indicates whether cases may require multiple calculators, and “Nestedcalculator” indicates whether cases involve dependencies between calculators.

Table 3: Main results on the nested-calculator tasks. “Dep Detect” denotes Dependency Detection Accuracy, “Overall” denotes Parent Calculator Score Accuracy, and “Sub Overall” denotes Sub-calculator Score Accuracy.
Figure 2: Overview of our framework. This agent contains four stages: Query Rewriting, Retrieval and Reranking, Tool Selection, and Tool Execution.
